deals.travelWindow: Feb 13 – Apr 24, 2027 (new Allegiant route; intro one-way from $49)
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant intro fares from $49 one-way (about $98+ round trip) on new BOS–SFB nonstop starting Feb 13, 2027; Wekiwa Springs and Ocala NF within ~1 h.
deals.soloScore: Cheap base for Orlando and the Space Coast, but SFB is a small airport and a car is practically required.

highlights: Wekiwa Springs spring swim and paddling
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown Sanford riverwalk, Lake Monroe sunset
Day 2 — Blue Spring State Park manatees, then Wekiwa Springs paddle
Day 3 — Canaveral National Seashore morning, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Rental car needed; SFB is ~35 min from Orlando proper.
guide.stayArea: Downtown Sanford for walkable dining near the riverfront.

deals.travelWindow: Feb 13 – Apr 24, 2027 (new Allegiant route; intro one-way from $49)
deals.whyRanked: New Allegiant BOS–PGD nonstop from Feb 13, 2027 with intro one-way from $49; Myakka River State Park ~40 min and Everglades gateway region nearby.
deals.soloScore: Small, walkable harbor town with a bike-friendly Harborwalk; quiet rather than social.

highlights: Punta Gorda Harborwalk and Fishermen's Village
Myakka River canopy walkway and boat tour
Boca Grande day trip via Gasparilla Island
itinerary: Day 1 — Harborwalk, sunset at Laishley Park
Day 2 — Myakka River State Park canopy walkway and airboat tour
Day 3 — Kayak the Peace River, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Rental car for parks and beaches; downtown is walkable.

deals.travelWindow: Feb 13 – Apr 24, 2027 (new Allegiant route; intro one-way from $49)
deals.whyRanked: New Allegiant BOS–PIE nonstop from Feb 13, 2027 with intro one-way from $49; walkable and arts-rich, with Fort De Soto and Egmont Key nearby.
deals.soloScore: One of Florida's most walkable downtowns with museums, a pier and a waterfront trail, easy to do solo without a car.

highlights: St. Pete Pier and Waterfront Trail
Central Ave murals and Warehouse Arts District
Fort De Soto beaches and bike trails
itinerary: Day 1 — St. Pete Pier, Dalí Museum, Central Ave
Day 2 — Fort De Soto Park by bike or car; Egmont Key ferry
Day 3 — Warehouse Arts District murals, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable with free Looper trolley and scooters; car helpful for Fort De Soto.
